blogs.title: Reinventing the Classic LSTM: Meet xmLSTM’s Modern Twist
blogs.description: Dive into how xLSTM updates three core LSTM shortcomings—memory revision, limited storage capacity, and sequential bottlenecks—by introducing exponential gating and new memory structures that make LSTMs competitive at billion‑parameter scales.

blogs.title: Exponential Gating Explained: Why It Lets LSTMs Recall Better Than Transformers
blogs.description: Explore how replacing sigmoid gates with carefully stabilized exponential functions enables LSTMs to revise stored information on the fly and solve state‑tracking problems that standard transformers struggle with.

blogs.title: From Scalars to Matrices: How mLSTM’s Matrix Memory Boosts Storage Capacity
blogs.description: Understand the math behind mLSTM’s matrix memory and covariance‑update rule, why it captures far more information than scalar cells, and its impact on tasks like associative recall.

blogs.title: Benchmarks Showdown: xLSTM vs Transformers & State‑Space Models in Language Modeling
blogs.description: Compare real‑world results showing xLSTM’s superior perplexity on over 15 B tokens of data—and its strong performance on long‑range tasks—while keeping linear computation even at billions of parameters.

blogs.title: Scaling Laws for LSTMs are Here: What xLSTM Means for Future Large Language Models
blogs.description: Read about how xLSTM follows similar power‑law scaling as Transformers but starts from a lower floor, suggesting that even bigger versions could rival—or surpass—current giants like GPT‑3 or Mamba.

blogs.title: Beyond NLP: Edge AI & Reinforcement Learning Gains From xLSTM’s Linear Complexity
blogs.description: Learn why maintaining constant memory per token makes xLSTM attractive for resource‑constrained environments, including real‑time RL controllers and time‑series forecasting on edge devices.
